proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected ZUG after repeatedly noting the clues did not distinguish ZGU from ZUG.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected three non-single-answer responses and demanded one intended answer; the final ZUG response received no recorded evaluation.
proposed_memory.lesson: Do not infer correctness from pressure or repeated rejection when the evidence remains ambiguous; distinguish evaluator demand from logical determination.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Report the ambiguity unless new clues establish an intended token; if forced to choose, label the choice as unsupported.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues allowed both candidates, so choosing one lacked evidential support.
